name: A10-0121/2026 – Isabella Lövin – § 3 – Am 25
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: 3. Urges the Commission and Member States to commit to a comprehensive and cross-sectoral plan that addresses all major stressors in the Baltic Sea – including nutrient pollution, chemical contaminants, offshore energy, climate change and predator impacts – while ensuring inclusive governance and maritime spatial planning that involves the fisheries sector; emphasises that these pressures are transboundary and cumulative, requiring EU-level coordination and the avoidance of measures that could undermine the socio-economic stability of coastal communities;
